title: Silicon Sample Benchmark — Tier 1 (individual simulation) submission (team team_31)

creators.name: Holtdirk, Tobias
creators.affiliation: LMU Munich, SODA Lab (Social Data Science and AI Lab)

description: Analysis-first structural prediction of the megastudy's 16 x 13 treatment-effect table (outcome-level base effect + low-rank message loading + sparse assertion-match terms), every constant estimated from a train split of 11 published message experiments; Tier-1 rows synthesised backwards from the table under census quotas. Built by an autonomous LLM agent (claude-opus-5 in an agent harness) working inside an environment that scored it only on fresh respondent-halves of held-out studies with a 2-submission budget, attenuation-corrected diagnostics, and a leave-one-study-out promotion gate; no human edited any prediction. Registered team: Tobias Holtdirk, Bolei Ma; the agent sessions for this entry were operated by contributor Haiwen Huang.
